proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: First the statement is shown to make sense: over a perfect field k the reduced closed subscheme Z whose underlying space is the closure of the image of a is geometrically reduced over k via either projection (Varieties, perfect-reduced), hence the fibre product Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z inside Z is reduced (Varieties, geometrically-reduced-any-base-change). By the map-groupoids-on-field-image lemma the composition c then induces a morphism Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z to Z. The identity section e_2 visibly factors through Z and the inverse i_2 preserves Z, and since the septuple (U, R_2, s_2, t_2, c_2, e_2, i_2) satisfies the groupoid axioms, the restrictions of s_2, t_2, c_2 to Z satisfy them as well, so (U, Z, s_2|_Z, t_2|_Z, c_2|_Z) is a groupoid scheme over S. (source lines 1794-1812)
